newsitem.title: CHINA: China hopes for $140 million in loans from Kuwait.
newsitem.headline: China hopes for $140 million in loans from Kuwait.

text.p: China is hoping for a total of $140 million in soft loans from Kuwait after recently receiving more than $30 million in long-term credit, the International Business Daily said on Tuesday.

The Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development on Monday extended a 10 million dinar ($33.5 million) loan to help finance a project in China providing irrigation and other infrastructure for resettled farmers.

The International Business Daily said the 24-year loan was the first phase in Kuwaiti funding for the project in western China's poverty-stricken Ningxia region and would carry an interest rate of 2.5 percent per annum.
More than 99 percent of the loan could be used for purchases on the domestic market, it said but gave no details.
The newspaper said Kuwait had promised another $53 million loan for the same project, and that China hoped total Kuwaiti credit for the project would reach $140 million.
